tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus kyi 'pho 'gyur dang gang zag gi rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas gangs can mkhas grub rim byon rnams kyis ngal ba khyad du bsad nas bsgrubs pa'i thugs kyi nying khu lta bu'i gsung 'bum ches mang po zhig gi dpe rgyun stong la nye ba dang*/ lhag par gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po'i gsung ni skabs de shed du khong gi lta ba'i 'khyer so rje tsong kha pa chen po dang cung zad mi mthun pa lta bu'i thugs snang dang gleng phyogs la brten dar rgyas de tsam byung yod bzo ma mchis kyang*| phyis gung ru'i gsung 'bum cha tshang ba zhig shing par du brkos nas ser smad grwa tshang gi rkang 'dzin yig char gyur ste 'chad nyan gyis dar spel cung zad byung yod/ 'on kyang sngar gyi dbu ma'i lta ba'i thad kyi gleng gzhi'i thog phyogs phyogs kyi mkhas pa dag gis gung ru'i yig cha 'di bzhin dar rgyas cher song tshe rje tsong kha pa'i bzhed gzhung la lhad skyon zhugs par dogs pa sogs kyis dgag bya rgyun mthud byung ba sogs la brten/ dam pa de nyid kyi gsung yig cha'i mthil du 'dzin pa'i ser smad grwa tshang du yang sngar yod yig cha nas/ phyis mkhas grub bstan dar ba'i yig char kha bsgyur mdzad de rim bzhin/ dam pa 'di nyid kyi gsung la 'chad nyan lta zhog mig gi lta ba tsam yang mi rung ba'i tshod du byed mod/ blo gros can gyi mthong na mkhas pa mgu ba'i legs bshad mang du yod kyang rgya khyab tu byed mkhan ma byung ba'i khar/ sngar yod par shing rnams kyang me lha'i zhal du phangs med du btabs yod tshul sogs gang gi gsung gi 'phrin las rta bdun dbang por bar chad chu 'dzin gyi gseb tu nub pa las/ da cha dpe rgyun shin tu dkon pa'i khar chos tshan re zung bzhugs pa'ang mdo dbus khams gsum du kha 'thor nas yod pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig ni phyi rgyal gyi dpe mdzod khang re 'gar yod tshul thos pa las gsung 'bum cha tshang ba zhig da bar btsal rnyed thub med/

da lta dngos su btsal rnyed thub pa'i dam pa gang gi gsung 'bum gyi gras las / par bskrun zhu rgyu gsham gsal ¡¶sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa byams pa'i dgongs rgyan ¡·dang*/¡¶dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa/¡·¡¶sher phyin mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog¡·¡¶dbu ma 'jug pa'i rnam bshad rten 'byung gi de nyid gsal byed/¡·¡¶rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa/¡·¡¶stong thun bsdus pa ¡·¡¶legs bshad bla ma'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ¡·zhes pa stong thun 'bring po bcas chos tshan khag bdun yod pa rnams las/ sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa byams pa'i dgongs rgyan 'di nyid ni sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa du ma yod pa rnams kyi nang nas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rgyan du sbyar zhing*/ bstan bcos kyi 'grel gtso bor byas nas tshig don bde blag tu rtogs pa'i thabs 'grel pa don gsal la brten nas 'chad pa dang*/ gzhung gi spyi khog yangs shing tshig nyog gis lo mas ma bsgribs par dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum dang 'tsham par don bdun cu dang*| mngon par rtogs pa brgyad dang*/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi sgo nas bstan bcos kyi gzhung don spyir 'grel pa dang*/ nyams len gyi gnas rnams zur du bkol nas 'chad pa sogs legs bshad du snang bas/ nged dpe tshogs kyis deb dang por par bskrun byas pa yin/ dam pa gang gi lta ba'i khyer so rje tsong kha pa dang mthun mi mthun dang*/ mkhas grub rjes dam pa 'di'i gsung gi 'phrin las rgyas su mi 'jug ched dam can chos rgyal la gnyer gtad kyi dgag dgos ci rigs yod srid par mno bsam gyi ngal ba ye ma byas par/ mi rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phel gyi blo dkar lhag bsam 'ba' zhig gis kun nas bslangs te/ gang sar ma dpe btsal 'tshol gyi ngal ba mang du brten mthar gsung gi lhag mar gyur pa gong zhus kyi gsung 'di rnams par bskrun zhu thub tsam byung ba yang skal bzang gi bgo skal zhig tu rlom/

'on kyang dga' snang gi khrod du blo pham dgos pa zhig ni dam pa gang gi gsung 'bum gras stong thun rgyas pa dang*/ dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa/ chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos mkhas pa dga' bskyed/ dbu ma'i lta khrid/ mdzod 'dul sogs kyi mtshan byang tsam las ma dpe btsal rnyed thub med/ gong gsal par bskrun zhus pa'i dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa 'di'i ma dpe shing par yin 'dug rung ma dpe'i yig tshogs nag nog che zhing shog grangs lnga pa dang drug pa gnyis nang dum bu 'ga' zhig snag rdzob tu gyur te yig ngo chod thabs bral shis rje tsong kha pa'i 'jug 'grel dgongs pa rab gsal dang*/ rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa'i 'jug 'grel gsal ba'i me long*/ de bzhin rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i 'jug 'grel gsal ba'i rgyan gsum dang bstun nas kha bskang ba'i rigs rtags【】'di'i nang bcug yod/ rnal 'byor spyod pa bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa 'di'i ma dpe lag bris yin pa ma zad skung yig mang ba'i khar nag nog che bar brten mi gsal ba'i rigs rnams dpal ldan zla ba'i bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa dang*/ rje btsun re 'da' ba chen po'i 'grel bshad tshig don gsal ba dang*/ rgyal tshab chos rje'i bzhi brgya pa'i dar ṭīka bcas su gsal ba rnams kyis kha bskangs pa yin/ rab byed drug pa dang bdun pa gnyis go rim ldog ste bkod pa ni yig mkhan gyi thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i dbang gis yin pa las de min dgos pa lhag po gang yang med pa ma zad gzhung dngos kyi sa bcad dang mi mthun pas bzo bcos mi byed thabs med red 'dug pas bzod par gsol/ sher phyin mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog 'di yang ma dpe bris rnying skung yig mang zhing yig 'bru mi gsal ba zhig 'dug rung sher phyin gyi spyi khog cha tshang la tshig nyung zhing don bsdus pa'i rgyan 'grel gzhan las khyad du zhugs pa zhig tu snang*|

skung yig dang yig 'bru mi gsal ba'i rigs rnams rgyan 'grel gzhan dang bstun nas bkral ba tsam las ma dpe sor bzhag yin zhing de'i thad don gnyer can rnams kyi thugs dogs mi dgos/ ma dpe dang dpe bsdur zhu bde'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang rgyab mdun so so'i ang rtags gsal por bkod yod pa bcas kyi thog ma dpe dang bsdur te zhus dag thengs gsum tsam byas nas spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rlom yang nongs pa'i tshogs mi nyung ba zhig yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams pas dgongs 'char lhug par stsol ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas so// //dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas grwa blo bzang stobs bcus bkod/mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal mtshan bzang po'i gsung chos kyi skor/bsdu sgrig gsal bsha/ -PAGE 4--PAGE 5--PAGE 1-
